title: Analytic: two-photon absorption and Kerr phase of a slab (FDTD, nonlinear)
description:
A cw plane wave (mode_source, 1 um, peak field A_peak) crosses a 2 um nonlinear_medium slab of n0 = 1 (no linear reflection) with Kerr n2 = 3e-18 m^2/W and two-photon absorption beta = 7.5e-11 m/W, in a y-periodic vacuum strip (20 nm cells, CPML along x); sweep A_peak = 0.2..1.5 GV/m (I0 = c eps0 A^2 / 2 up to 3e15 W/m^2).
Analytic (cycle-averaged plane-wave ODE dI/dz = -beta I^2, dphi/dz = k0 n2 I): T = 1 / (1 + beta I0 L); phi_NL = (k0 n2 / beta) ln(1 + beta I0 L) (0.002..0.093 rad; T down to 0.69).
Sweep tab: T_out (probe power over the last 100 periods / (A^2 / 2)) and phi_NL (mode monitor phase_positive minus the discrete linear phase -k_num (x_mon - x_src), k_num from the FDTD dispersion) vs A_peak with their dashed references; dashed extras: phi_kerr_only = k0 n2 I0 L (no TPA depletion) and T_first_order = 1 - beta I0 L. P_in (upstream probe) checks the launched amplitude (reference 1).
Probes tab: probe_out with the dashed envelope +-A sqrt(T); probe_in with the ramped incident envelope A (1 - exp(-t / 3T)).
Expected: T_out ~0.3-1 % (the phase-matched third harmonic adds ~(phi_NL)^2 of the power at the probe, the TPA lag), phi_NL up to ~9 % at 1.5 GV/m (outside the cycle-averaged ODE: in the dispersion-free n0 = 1 slab the third harmonic is phase matched and, its Kerr and TPA drives being in quadrature, cascades back as a phase loss ~(2/3) (beta / (2 k0 n2)) phi_NL^2, ~0.2 % at 0.2 GV/m; the cw ramp at the start of the 2 ps DFT ~0.4 %), P_in within ~2 |r| = |n2 I0 - j beta I0 / (2 k0)| (the slab front reflects through its Kerr and TPA index step: a standing wave at the upstream probe, up to ~2 % at 1.5 GV/m, ~0.1 % at 0.2 GV/m). phase_raw = phase_positive against wrap(phi_lin - phi_NL) checks the absolute phase convention: its error is the phi_NL one (~9 mrad of ~3 rad at 1.5 GV/m), a dt / 2 timing slip would add omega dt / 2 = 44 mrad.

parameters.name: A_peak
parameters.description: peak E_z [V/m] of the launched cw plane wave (sweep 0.2-1.5 GV/m)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the cw source

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 [1/m]

parameters.name: T_period
parameters.description: optical period [s]

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (50 cells per wavelength, 16.7 at the third harmonic)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML on both x faces)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: periodic y period (5 cells)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_in
parameters.description: upstream probe x (cell 75 centre)

parameters.name: x_slab
parameters.description: slab front face (on a cell edge)

parameters.name: L_slab
parameters.description: slab length L (100 cells)

parameters.name: x_mon
parameters.description: mode monitor line behind the slab (cell 225 centre)

parameters.name: x_out
parameters.description: downstream probe x (cell 250 centre)

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: probe y (cell 2 centre)

parameters.name: n2_kerr
parameters.description: Kerr coefficient n2 [m^2/W]

parameters.name: beta_tpa
parameters.description: two-photon absorption beta [m/W]

parameters.name: I0
parameters.description: incident intensity [W/m^2] (n0 = 1)

parameters.name: P_src
parameters.description: mode source power [W/m] that gives the peak field A_peak

parameters.name: T_ref
parameters.description: analytic TPA power transmission

parameters.name: phi_ref
parameters.description: analytic Kerr phase delay [rad] along the TPA-depleted intensity

parameters.name: n_run
parameters.description: run length in optical periods (2 ps; the cw ramp then biases the DFT phase by ~0.4 %)

parameters.name: n_fit
parameters.description: periods at the end of the run averaged by the probe derived values

parameters.name: t_run
parameters.description: study duration [s]

parameters.name: t_fit
parameters.description: start of the averaging window [s]

parameters.name: dt_fdtd
parameters.description: FDTD time step at courant 0.99 on square cells [s]

parameters.name: k_num
parameters.description: discrete FDTD vacuum wavenumber along x [1/m] (Yee dispersion in space and time)

parameters.name: phi_lin
parameters.description: linear (vacuum) phase of the monitor relative to the source [rad]

parameters.name: phi_raw_ref
parameters.description: analytic phase_positive of the monitor, wrapped into (-pi, pi]
